# netbox_cable_bundle (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get Cable Bundle by Name
data "netbox_cable_bundle" "test" {
  name = "bundle-a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.

### Read-Only
